nameOrigin: type of helmet used by ancient Japanese warriors

pokedexEntries.rb: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

pokedexEntries.ye: A POKéMON that was recovered from a fossil. It uses the eyes on its back while hiding on the sea floor.

pokedexEntries.go: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

pokedexEntries.si: This POKéMON lived in ancient times. On rare occasions, it has been discovered as a living fossil.

pokedexEntries.cr: Three hundred million years ago, it hid on the sea floor. It also has eyes on its back that glow.

pokedexEntries.rs: KABUTO is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The POKéMON has not changed at all for 300 million years.

pokedexEntries.fr: This POKéMON was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

pokedexEntries.lg: A POKéMON that was regenerated from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor long ago.

pokedexEntries.em: It is a POKéMON that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in rare cases, living examples have been discovered. KABUTO have not changed for 300 million years.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

pokedexEntries.hg: On rare occasions, some have been found as fossils which they became while hiding on the ocean floor.

pokedexEntries.ss: This Pokémon lived in ancient times. On rare occasions, it has been discovered as a living fossil.

pokedexEntries.bw: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

pokedexEntries.x: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a stiff shell.

pokedexEntries.y: This Pokémon was regenerated from the fossil of an ancient creature. It protects itself with a hard shell.

pokedexEntries.oras: Kabuto is a Pokémon that has been regenerated from a fossil. However, in extremely rare cases, living examples have been discovered. The Pokémon has not changed at all for 300 million years.

pokedexEntries.us: This Pokémon thrived 300 million years ago. It’s said that living specimens can still be seen in a certain region—a rare sight.

pokedexEntries.um: This Pokémon became extinct everywhere, except in a few areas. It protects itself with its hard shell.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: A Pokémon that was recovered from a fossil. It used the eyes on its back while hiding on the seafloor.

pokedexEntries.sw: This species is almost entirely extinct. Kabuto molt every three days, making their shells harder and harder.

pokedexEntries.sh: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a sturdy shell.
